dialogues.speaker: Lemta
dialogues.text: Things are still such a mess... I didn't do that well in the competition either. It feels like my bad luck's spilling over like pilaf from an overfilled pot...

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: Ah, perfect timing. An expert, just when I needed one.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: What do you think of my hairstyle?

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: That's a very polite way to put it. You're too kind.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: A while ago, when I was passing through Fontaine, Ophelia kept raving about her hairstylist, so I went and got myself a "fashionable new look."

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: In Sumeru, only the wealthier ladies can call in a real expert and spend hours getting a style like this done.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: It was only afterward that I realized this hairstyle doesn't go with my face or my outfit at all... I really regret it.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: Once I'm back in Sumeru City, I'll have to figure out how to change myself back. Otherwise, Avena is definitely going to tease me about it.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: She's an incredible adventurer. She manages all the supplies for the entire Fontaine branch of the Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: Back when we were exploring the desert, there was a misunderstanding between her and the mercenary company I was with at the time. Things got out of hand, and she ended up taking down seven of us.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: Later, Lady Candace stepped in and smoothed things over. Ophelia actually covered an entire year's worth of water expenses for us. An entire year!

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: That's the kind of money we would usually spend three months earning. If anything, she was a little too sincere.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: The sad thing is, I heard she was badly injured when some out-of-control experimental field-force device came crashing down on her. She did recover, but she couldn't really stay on the front lines afterward.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: Otherwise, she'd probably be competing here too.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: Next time there's an event like this, maybe I'll bring her along to watch.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: A sweet, innocent young lady. She's my employer — the one I'm here to protect.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: She chose me as her bodyguard because she said we "just clicked" when we met, and promised to introduce me to some amazing adventurers.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: As it turned out, they were all bright-eyed rookies with big dreams, kind hearts, and no idea how dangerous the world can be. Some of them even had mentors I'd beaten before.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: She funds the entire team without expecting anything in return... She's almost unbelievably generous, in that innocent way of hers.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: That's why I don't mind tagging along and carrying her bags. I want to see this team grow into something...

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: ...Provided she doesn't empty her purse first. She needs someone to help her judge what's worth the money, so I'll keep an eye on her.

choices.text: It doesn't really suit you, somehow.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: Right? That's because I never used to wear my hair like this.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: ...Perhaps. If you've ever turned in commissions at the Adventurers' Guild in Sumeru City, you might have seen me there with my employer.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: Over the years, my employer and I would often stop there to rest after buying supplies.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: I usually ended up taking care of certain commissions for her... ones she never quite realized were as difficult as they were.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: So Branch Master Kamal gave me a part-time adventurer's certificate as well. It's worked out rather well — I can earn a little extra Mora that way.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: If he hadn't suddenly decided on a whim to spend his vacation out at sea, he would have been the one leading Sumeru's team.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: He's rather carefree, really. Since I've helped him more than forty times already, he even felt comfortable leaving meetings like this to me. I can hardly let him down now, can I?

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: Mm, I seem to have gotten a little off topic...

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: Anyway, if we ever get the chance, we should work together. My employer is rather generous, you know.

choices.text: Then here's hoping your luck changes for the better today.

response.speaker: Lemta
response.text: Thank you. I hope the same for you.
